name: libtrack
description: Root dev scripts. The apps keep their own package.json and lockfile; Vercel builds each from its own directory.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/backend ci && npm --prefix apps/frontend ci && npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently --kill-others -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix apps/backend run vercel:dev" "PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:${API_PORT:-3000}/api npm --prefix apps/frontend run dev"
scripts.check: npm --prefix apps/backend run build && npm --prefix apps/backend test && npm --prefix apps/frontend run check
